Diego / Sam,

Thanks — Nina from tax here. For a Mexican entity supplying services to Redwood, we need one of the following to satisfy our vendor tax verification:

- Government-issued RFC confirmation (digital extract) matching the legal business name on the invoice; OR
- A notarized certificate of existence/registration that lists the RFC; OR
- A third-party tax verification report (SAT extract).

If the RFC in the W-8BEN-E matches the legal name and you can provide a scanned certificate of foreign status or the SAT extract, we can clear tax classification and remove the PO hold. If you do not have a US EIN, that is okay — we just need consistent foreign tax evidence.

Monica: keep PO 45789 on hold until tax confirms. Sam: can you send the certificate at your earliest? If DocuSign is easier, a signed attachment link works too.

-Neha
Tax & Compliance
Redwood Inference
